title: 科加斯·一口小蛋糕
description: 紫红色科加斯缩成圆润友好的怪兽轮廓，用大爪托着小纸杯蛋糕，尖角柔和处理。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Cho'Gath is a large red-purple Void monster with a broad armored carapace, multiple pointed limb silhouettes, prominent head horns, and a long heavy tail. Keep the distinctive bulky insectoid-dinosaur body rather than a generic pet, but round the horns and claws into wax-crayon shapes. His closed mouth and curious bright eyes should look friendly, with no exposed gore or frightening teeth.
art_direction.scene: He crouches contentedly beside a little picnic stool and balances a tiny cupcake on the flat of one enormous claw. The cupcake has one pastel berry and no candle. A few simple flowers and a small cloth napkin emphasize the scale contrast, while the full tail and every major limb fit comfortably within the warm paper square.
art_direction.palette: plum red, dark violet, cream frosting, berry pink
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
